writeup: Woot has the BIC Xtra-Sparkle 15-count pack of 0.7mm mechanical pencils for $2.99, about 20 cents per pencil. Walgreens lists the same 15-pack at $7.49 and CVS at $7.79. Each pencil uses No. 2 lead that's fine for standardized tests, and you advance the lead by clicking the eraser. Barrel colors vary, limit 5 per customer, and shipping is free for Prime members.
